en.t: You really are still a child.

units.source_text: 他尽力装出父亲的口气，然而玉鬘看了非常厌恶。

en.t: He did his best to adopt a fatherly tone, but Tamakazura found it deeply repulsive.

units.source_text: 但倘置之不复，又恐别人疑讶，便在一张厚厚的陆奥纸上写道：

en.t: But if she left it unanswered, she feared others would grow suspicious, so she wrote on a thick sheet of Michinoku paper:
I have now respectfully read your letter.

units.source_text: 只因心绪恶劣，乞恕未能详复。”

en.t: Because I am in such poor spirits, please forgive me for being unable to reply in detail.

units.source_text: 源氏看了回信，微笑着想道：

en.t: Genji read the reply and thought with a smile:

units.source_text: “照这态度看来，此人毕竟很有骨气。”

en.t: Judging from this attitude, she does have real spirit after all.

units.source_text: 他觉得对此人申恨诉怨，虽然颇有意思，却是很麻烦的。

en.t: He felt that airing his resentment and grievances to her would be rather interesting, but also very troublesome.
